desc: Derive a rigorous lemma for S=Σ_B B^p using Σ_{F_p^*}=Σ_{F_p}−(value at 0) and test it against Samples 1–3 by hand or with a tiny brute force for small N,p.

Try to construct a quotient/semiring for matrix entries under the per-variable summation operator, reducing exponents modulo p-1 for nonzero variables, and determine when lower-degree terms can survive for total degree p.

Investigate whether the result simplifies to a small correction around A^p (e.g. terms involving walks whose zero-cell variables have exponent exactly p-1) and characterize those corrections combinatorially.
If a closed form is found, implement O(N^3 log p) or O(N^3 polylog p) modular arithmetic with careful handling of p up to 1e9 (use 64-bit multiplication or built-in big ints in Python).
Fuzz the current solution against a brute-force enumerator for N≤4 and p≤7 (including p=2, K=0, and dense/sparse matrices) to verify the formula, and hand-verify Sample 3.
